heading: the short version
paragraphs: I'm a junior at Bayonne High School who likes building things people actually use: small apps, automation scripts, and the occasional piece of hardware.

Most of my time right now goes into Holos, a personal health app that pulls in data from wearables. Before that I mostly built tools for myself, like a screen-time tracker, a Slack reminder bot, and a script that summarizes the morning announcements.
A lot of it started with Hack Club. Hackathons taught me to ship something by the deadline, and writing about my projects taught me to explain them.
